provider: Claude Code workflows in this session
how_run: label_batches.js: one fresh subagent per batch reads the prompt v1 system prompt and its papers (two 50-paper files) and returns labels through a structured-output schema; papers shuffled into batches of 100
notes: First pass = trial run on the 2,300 reference papers (same protocol) + 412 batches for the other 41,180 papers. Second pass = 22 separate batches with fresh agents for the 2,174 ids in double_label_ids.txt; agents never saw first-pass labels. 4 papers (2 first pass, 2 second pass) were not returned on the first try (id copied wrongly) and were re-asked once, each by a fresh agent. Temperature cannot be set for subagents.
